title: Server: member count in the v1 workspace response
whatToBuild: A team member who loads a workspace gets its member count from the server: the workspace service's getWorkspace returns memberCount, the number of memberships the workspace has, and GET /api/v1/workspaces/:slug returns it beside every field it returned before, so installed mobile builds keep working.
testBoundaries: the workspace service's getWorkspace and GET /api/v1/workspaces/:slug through their exports in apps/web/test/ with node:test, asserting on memberCount

acceptanceCriteria.text: getWorkspace returns memberCount, the workspace's number of memberships, for one member and for several
GET /api/v1/workspaces/:slug returns memberCount and every field it returned before, none renamed or removed
